meta.title: Collaborative Submission Review: refused for a user without the Buyer role
gaps: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Collaborative Submission Review is refused or absent.
Repeat the Collaborative Submission Review action as a Buyer and verify that collaborative editing is available.
Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant and inspect any tenant RBAC configuration that explains the result.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Sign in as a user without the Buyer role and verify that Collaborative Submission Review is refused or absent.; Repeat the Collaborative Submission Review action as a Buyer and verify that collaborative editing is available.; Compare the two role outcomes in the same tenant and inspect any tenant RBAC configuration that explains the result.

args.need: sign in as a user without the Buyer role, try to edit a vendor submission with Collaborative Submission Review before finalizing, then repeat the same action as a Buyer and report whether the action is refused, absent, or available

steps.note: Role-specific sessions and the Collaborative Submission Review feature are not expressible by any catalog step.
Confirm the session remains free of an application error after the tester's role comparison.
